headline: Brandon Miller out with a hip strain; Charlotte also loses Schröder and Knueppel
take: Miller stays on IR. No timeline, so don't count on him this week or next.

headline: Quickley questionable for Monday
take: Shead is the cover. Once Quickley is back, Shead (-2.2 value) is the first drop.

headline: Achiuwa is droppable in 12-team leagues
take: His minutes fell to 19 over the last week. He's the natural drop for a Saturday streamer.

headline: Wendell Carter Jr.'s 63% FG is unsustainable
take: He shot 51% last season. Expect FG% to cool, but his rebounds and blocks still fit this build.
